title: Witness Round-Up
summary: Three witnesses to the mooring-fee dispute are ducking their subpoenas across the skydocks — one claims a storm knee, one claims cargo wash, one has simply gone vertical up a mast. Sister Counterweight's circuit hearing convenes when your skids cross the exchange yard, and her gavel does not reschedule. Round them up, swear them in, be quick about it.

objectives.label: Make the winch base before the gavel convenes
Round up the three reluctant witnesses around Keel Town
Present all three at the hearing before the gavel falls

offer.text: Courier. The Office of the Counterweight requires persons. Three (3) witnesses to what the moorage fees actually paid for — a ruling depends on it, and the hearing depends on them, and they depend, apparently, on being physically fetched from the skydocks like overdue weather.

Their excuses are on file and rejected as follows: the storm knee is healed and flinches theatrically; the cargo wash dried two days ago; the one who has 'gone vertical' is a rigger and considers mast-height a legal address. It is not. I have checked. Twice. Fetch them before the gavel convenes. The gavel keeps its own calendar and shares nothing with me.

accept.text: Serving subpoenas by hover-bike. The Driftline oath covers any crate, any storm, any door — nobody said anything about *plaintiffs*.

Devanna Shore, skydocks. Counterweight told me you're collecting strays. They're all within shouting distance of Keel Town — hear the excuses and you'll find them: 'medical', 'maritime', and one long silence from up a mast. Take the winch line up and mind the gulls. The gulls are hostile and unaffiliated.

A note for your manifest, courier: witnesses travel as persons, not cargo. You may not stack them. This has been clarified before and, apparently, must be clarified again. The Guild regrets nothing and documents everything.

complete.text: Three witnesses, presented, sworn, and seated — one with sand still falling out of his testimony. The gavel approves of your timing, courier; it made a sound I can only describe as *early*. The record will show that justice was delivered like freight: intact, audited, and with the packing sand returned.

Shore here. Word up the winch is the fees go back to the mast fund, harbour-side. You've just rigged the docks for the next twenty seasons and all you carried was three liars and a clipboard. Good hauling, courier. The sky owes you one calm crossing.
Delivered: three people who did not want to arrive. On time, unstacked. Next time the manifest says 'persons', I'm reading the small print and the medium print.

Final entry, for your ledger and mine: a hearing is a weighing with chairs. Yours balanced. The Office keeps minutes of the strange sessions for the archive — couriers who fetch truth by hand may consult them. You'll find your season has a chapter already. It is filed under *early*.
